```{r}
rm(list = ls())
library(ggh4x)
source("../00_pck.R")
source("../00_dirs.R")

source("../fun_figures/fun_limits.R")
theme_set(theme_classic() + theme(strip.background = element_blank()))
```

# Raw data 
```{r}
# Read in the waic (only models that converged)
waic_df <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$modres}/all_waic.rds"))
waic_best <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$modres}/all_waicbest.rds"))
```

# Define main analyses 
```{r}
pat_sel <- c("rota", "hav", "hbv", "dipht", "tetan", "pertuwpt", "ipv1", 
             "hib", "menc", "strep04", "measl", "mumps", "rubel", "vzv")
```

# Define models converging
```{r}
df_converged <- filter(waic_df, dat %in% c("s08", "semeth_s08"), mod_out == "imm") %>%
  # The function needs arguments reg (NA for cs and "reg_x" for csi) and multi (multi pat)
  mutate(reg = case_when(str_detect(mod_name, "csi") ~ str_remove_all(mod_name, "csi_")), 
         multi = str_detect(pat, "multi"))
```

```{r}
# Extract covars coefficients
all_coefcovars <-readRDS(file = glue("{dirs$modres}/all_coefcovars.rds"))
# Extract random effects coefficients
all_coefre <- readRDS(file = glue("{dirs$modres}/all_coefre.rds"))
# Extract draws from the posterior for covars coefficients factors
all_samplecovarsfct <- readRDS(file = glue("{dirs$modres}/all_samplescovarsfct.rds"))
all_coefrescor <- readRDS(file = glue("{dirs$modres}/all_coefrescor.rds"))
all_samplesshape <- readRDS(file = glue("{dirs$modres}/all_samplesshape.rds"))
```

# Tidy parameteter names
```{r}
param_tidy_names <- data.frame(
  param = c("age", "sex", "time_vl_s1", "vac_conc", "time_v1_v2", "time_v2_v3", "reg_2", "reg_6", 
            "vac_name_v1"),
  param_tidy = c("Age", "Sex (M)", "Time Last-vaccination to \nImmunogenicity", "Vaccine concentration",
  "Time 1st-vaccination to \n2nd-vaccination", "Time 2nd-vaccination to \n3rd-vaccination", 
  "Region (North)", "Region (Temperate)", "Vaccine")) %>%
  mutate(param_tidy = factor(param_tidy, levels = c(
    "Age", "Sex (M)", "Time Last-vaccination to \nImmunogenicity", 
    "Time 1st-vaccination to \n2nd-vaccination", "Time 2nd-vaccination to \n3rd-vaccination", 
    "Vaccine concentration", "Region (Temperate)", "Region (North)", "Vaccine")))
```

# Prepare data 
```{r}
# Prepare covars 
datpl_l <- list()
# Data for not factors
datpl_l$nfct <- filter(all_coefcovars, pat %in% pat_sel, dat == "s08", mod %in% waic_best$mod_best, 
                       !(param %in% c("Intercept", "reg_2", "reg_3", "reg_4", "reg_6", "vac_name_v1"))) %>%
  left_join(param_tidy_names, by = join_by(param)) %>%
  #left_join(tidy_namesmini_pat, by = join_by(pat_tidy)) %>%
  mutate(sig = case_when(est_ci95lo > 0 ~ "pos", est_ci95up < 0 ~ "neg"))
# Data from uvn models 
datpl_l$fct <- filter(all_coefcovars, pat %in% pat_sel, dat == "s08", mod %in% waic_best$mod_best,
                      param %in% c("Intercept", "reg_2", "reg_3", "reg_4", "reg_6", "vac_name_v1")) %>%
  left_join(param_tidy_names, by = join_by(param)) %>%
  #left_join(tidy_namesmini_pat, by = join_by(pat_tidy)) %>%
  mutate(sig = case_when(est_ci95lo > 0 ~ "pos", est_ci95up < 0 ~ "neg"))
# Data from re 
datpl_l$re <- filter(all_coefre, pat %in% pat_sel, dat == "s08", mod %in% waic_best$mod_best) #%>%
  #left_join(tidy_namesmini_pat, by = join_by(pat_tidy))
datpl_l$shape <- filter(all_samplesshape, pat %in% pat_sel, dat == "s08", mod %in% waic_best$mod_best) %>%
  mutate(est = 1/sqrt(estimate) * 100) %>%
  group_by(mod, param, waic, pat, mod_out, mod_name, reg, dat, vac, gauss, multi, pat_tidy, Rhat_cond, waic_diff) %>%
  summarise(est_ci95lo = round(quantile(est, 0.025), digits = 3), 
            est_ci95up = round(quantile(est, 0.975), digits = 3),
            est = round(mean(est), digits = 3))
```

```{r}
datpl_l$nfct %>%
  filter(param == "vac_conc") %>%
  arrange(est) %>%
  filter(sig == "neg") %>%
  #filter(str_detect(pat, "hav|meas|mump|rubel", negate = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(est = round(est*100, digits = 2), 
         est_ci95lo = round(est_ci95lo*100, digits = 2), 
         est_ci95up = round(est_ci95up*100, digits = 2))

datpl_l$fct %>% 
  filter(param == "vac_name_v1") %>%
  mutate(est = round(est*100, digits = 2), 
         est_ci95lo = round(est_ci95lo*100, digits = 2), 
         est_ci95up = round(est_ci95up*100, digits = 2))

percent_change <- function(beta) {
  100 * expm1(beta)
}

for (nm in c("nfct", "fct")) {
  datpl_l[[nm]] <- datpl_l[[nm]] %>%
    mutate(
      est = percent_change(est),
      est_ci95lo = percent_change(est_ci95lo),
      est_ci95up = percent_change(est_ci95up)
    )
}

datpl_l$nfct %>%
  filter(param == "vac_conc", !is.na(sig)) %>%
  select(pat, param_i, est, est_ci95lo, est_ci95up) %>%
  mutate(est = round(est, 2), 
         est_ci95lo = round(est_ci95lo, 2), 
         est_ci95up = round(est_ci95up, 2)) %>%
  arrange(est)
```




# Plot age, sex, time, time beween doses, time to serology, vaccine concentration
```{r}
col_sig <- c("orange", "#0D0887FF")
names(col_sig) <- c("pos", "neg")

pl_cov_l <- sapply(c("age", "sex", "time_vl_s1", "time_v1_v2", "time_v2_v3", "vac_conc"), function(x) {
  filter(datpl_l$nfct, param == x) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = est, y = reorder(pat_tidy, est), color = sig)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted", color = "grey") + 
    geom_point() +
    geom_segment(aes(x = est_ci95lo, xend = est_ci95up)) + 
    facet_grid(~param_tidy, scales = "free") + 
    scale_color_manual(values = col_sig) + 
    scale_x_continuous("Estimate (% change)") + 
    theme(legend.position = "none", 
          axis.title.y = element_blank(), 
          strip.text.x = element_text(hjust = 0))
}, simplify = FALSE)

pl_cov_l
```

pl_cov_l$reg <- filter(datpl_l$fct, str_detect(param, "reg")) %>%
  left_join(rename(tidy_names_clu, param_i = clu, param_i_tidy = clu_tidy), by = join_by(param_i)) %>%

               nest_line = TRUE, solo_line = TRUE) +

# Plot the MVN effects 

# Prepare data 
```{r}
# Function to make symmetric 
make_symmetric <- function(df) {

  metrics <- c("rescor", "rescor_se", "rescor_ci95lo", "rescor_ci95up")

  labs <- sort(unique(c(df$patuni1, df$patuni2)))

  grid <- expand_grid(patuni1 = labs, patuni2 = labs) %>%
    mutate(.a = pmin(patuni1, patuni2),
           .b = pmax(patuni1, patuni2))

  df_norm <- df %>%
    transmute(
      .a = pmin(patuni1, patuni2),
      .b = pmax(patuni1, patuni2),
      across(all_of(metrics))
    )

  out <- grid %>%
    left_join(df_norm, by = c(".a", ".b"), relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
    select(-.a, -.b) %>%
    mutate(
      rescor        = if_else(patuni1 == patuni2, 1, rescor),
      rescor_se     = if_else(patuni1 == patuni2, 0, rescor_se),
      rescor_ci95lo = if_else(patuni1 == patuni2, 1, rescor_ci95lo),
      rescor_ci95up = if_else(patuni1 == patuni2, 1, rescor_ci95up)
    )

  out
}

# Prepare data 
dat_rescor <- all_coefrescor %>%
  filter(mod_name == "base", pat != "multi_opv") %>%
  mutate(multipat = if_else(pat %in% c("multi_ipv", "multi_strep", "multi_men", "multi_pertua"), 
                            "Uni pathogen", "Multi pathogen"),
         pat_tidy = trimws(str_remove_all(pat_tidy, "multi"))) %>%
  select(pat, patuni1, patuni2, rescor, rescor_se, rescor_ci95lo, rescor_ci95up) %>%
  group_by(pat) %>%
  group_modify(~ make_symmetric(.x)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  left_join(tidy_names_pat, by = join_by(pat)) %>%
  left_join(rename_with(tidy_names_pat, ~paste0(.x, "uni1")), by = join_by(patuni1)) %>%
  left_join(rename_with(tidy_names_pat, ~paste0(.x, "uni2")), by = join_by(patuni2))
```

# Plot MVN effects  
```{r}
pl_cov_l$mvn <- dat_rescor %>%
  mutate(
    pat_tidy = str_remove_all(pat_tidy, " multi | multi"),
    pat_tidy = if_else(pat_tidy == "Men-Hib", "Hib-Men", pat_tidy), 
    pat_tidy = factor(pat_tidy, levels = c(
      "MMRV", "MMR", "Hib-Men", "DTP (A)", "DTP (W)", "N. men",  "S. pn10",  "S. pn7",
      "Pertu (A)", "Polio (I)")),
  patuni_mvntidy1 = factor(pat_tidyuni1, levels = c(
       "Diphteria", "Tetanus", "Pertu (A) PT", "Measles", "Mumps", "Rubella", "Varicella", "H. inf B", "N. men A", "N. men C",
       "Per PRN", "Per FHA", "Polio (I) 1", "Polio (I) 2", "Polio (I) 3", "S. pn 01", "S. pn 04", "S. pn 05",
       "S. pn 06a", "S. pn 06b", "S. pn 07f", "S. pn 09v", "S. pn 14", "S. pn 18c", "S. pn 19a",
       "S. pn 19f", "S. pn 23f")),
     patuni_mvntidy2 = factor(pat_tidyuni2, levels = c(
       "Diphteria", "Tetanus", "Pertu (A) PT", "Measles", "Mumps", "Rubella", "Varicella", "H. inf B", "N. men A", "N. men C",
       "Per PRN", "Per FHA", "Polio (I) 1", "Polio (I) 2", "Polio (I) 3", "S. pn 01", "S. pn 04", "S. pn 05",
       "S. pn 06a", "S. pn 06b", "S. pn 07f", "S. pn 09v", "S. pn 14", "S. pn 18c", "S. pn 19a",
       "S. pn 19f", "S. pn 23f"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = pat_tidyuni1, y = pat_tidyuni2, fill = rescor)) +
  geom_tile() + 
  scale_x_discrete("") + 
  scale_y_discrete("") + 
  facet_nested_wrap(pat_tidy~., scales= "free", ncol = 5) + 
  scale_fill_viridis("Correlation", direction = -1, option = "magma") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1))
pl_cov_l$mvn
```
